blockers.problem: AC1 says the FIRST blocking answer passes through byte for byte. The merge test has only one blocking hook. A mutant in hooks/itd_dispatch.py merge() that returns the last blocking answer (reversed(results)) leaves the suite at 79 passed, 0 failed. Needed: a case with two blocking hooks that asserts the first one's exact bytes and exit code.

AC1 says a hard gate that lies outside the hooks directory denies, and an advisory one stays silent. The only test uses the row '../ok.sh', which the table schema (SCRIPT_NAME_RE) already rejects, so the per-hook check in run_all() is never reached. A mutant that drops 'path.parent != hooks_dir' passes all tests, so a hook in the hooks directory that is a symlink to a file elsewhere would run. Needed: a symlink case, both hard and advisory.

AC1 says the dispatcher module fails closed on ANY BaseException while it loads. Only SystemExit at load is tested. A mutant in hooks/claude-dispatch.py that narrows 'except BaseException' to '(Exception, SystemExit)' passes all tests, so KeyboardInterrupt (or another BaseException) at load is not pinned.

The SubagentStop decision for a failed hard gate depends on stop_hook_active, and no test checks that. A mutant in merge() that calls failure_answer(event, reason) without stop_hook_active passes all tests. A hard gate that crashes in a SubagentStop that already continues because of a stop hook would then be blocked again, which can loop. Today stop_hook_active is tested only for the paths where the table, the payload or the dispatcher itself fails.

AC4 says a body with a here-document, case or backtick keeps the fail-closed sentinel. Every test case for these also hides a transport (rsync) that the parser finds without the sentinel, so the deny never proves the sentinel held. Mutants in hooks/check-predeploy-gate.sh _substitution_end() that turn off the '<<' check, the 'case' check, the unquoted backtick check or the backtick-inside-double-quotes check each pass all 161 tests. Only the comment and depth>8 cases are pinned. Needed: assert the sentinel directly, or use bodies whose deny comes only from the sentinel.

No check covers the AC6 claims that the ITD-PLAN-S5 verified record and followup move ride in this PR and that the session 5 a4 adjudication is in .itd/DECISIONS.md. The AC6 verificationCommand (scripts/validate_state.py .itd-memory/STATE.json .itd-memory/GOAL.json) reads only git-ignored local files, which are not part of the candidate diff. Removing the ITD-PLAN-S5 closedFollowups entry or the DECISIONS entry would leave it green. Needed: a check on the committed contract and DECISIONS, for example a run of verify_closure_delta / itd_closure_delta.py tied to this unit.
